objective.quadrature: normalized trapezoidal weights on each recorded grid; equal block weights
objective.incomplete_candidates: completion priority only; no truncated measured fit score
objective.force_support: native measured times within preintegration simulation support; no extrapolation
objective.angle_convention: ground foot pitch; positive toe-up; fixed shoe frame
objective.policy: raw simulation at every timestep, pre-20Hz cleaned reference only interpolated
objective.supplemental: foot pitch(.05rad scale,.25weight), onset plane velocity(.5m/s scale,.1weight), phase impulses/peaks/centroids and early braking
objective.effort_guard_note: 1.5x peak and2x rate of old controller with this fixed contact model; additional engineering guards, not physiological limits
objective.tracking_gate_note: Quadratic hinge on training_margin times the original six RMSE thresholds. Original validation limits remain unchanged and are evaluated separately.

ap_force_rate_residual.source: prepared reference grf_target_n (native force samples; filter provenance unverified)
ap_force_rate_residual.simulated_force: unfiltered engine AP force sampled at the native GRF clock
ap_force_rate_residual.target_rate: first difference of adjacent supplied native AP GRF samples; not bandwidth-calibrated
ap_force_rate_residual.weight: one time-normalized residual block over the full native force support

optimizer.name: fit_resident
optimizer.plateau_criterion: stop after plateau_patience consecutive iterations without cumulative loss improvement >= plateau_rtol * max(abs(anchor), 1e-12), anchor initialized from initial baseline rollout
optimizer.search_backend: GPU device-resident shared-controller Warp float64 kernels
optimizer.wall_budget: soft; admit next batch only with 1.1*slowest_completed_batch+0.05 s remaining; first poll mandatory; no convergence stop
optimizer.padding: bound-rejected or disabled slots remain allocated but are not integrated; other unused slots explore
optimizer.physics_worlds_scope: allocated launch slots; completed worlds and integrated steps count actual work
optimizer.candidate_count_scope: real proposal slots including baseline reevaluations; global unique count not tracked
optimizer.failed_initial: latched on device; later selection disabled; diagnostic returned at final unload
optimizer.final_replay: none (GPU snapshot; no host full-world replay)

refinement.reason: caller must run frozen half-step check separately

qualification: Numerical search only. No convergence, measured acceptance, or physical validation claim.
